subject.title: feat(mattermost): auto-engage on replies to the bot's own thread

question: Should Mattermost bot-root thread replies auto-engage by default without a config knob, and is the current unit/CI evidence enough or should a live Mattermost roundtrip be required before merge?
rationale: The patch is technically bounded, but it changes message delivery for existing requireMention/onchar rooms and ClawSweeper cannot choose the product policy or proof bar for maintainers.

options.title: Accept Default-On After Roundtrip
options.body: Maintainers accept the default-on parity behavior and require or explicitly waive a real Mattermost bot-authored thread reply proof before merge.

options.title: Land With Current Evidence
options.body: Maintainers accept the behavior and treat the current focused tests plus green CI as sufficient for this member-authored PR.

options.title: Pause For Opt-In Policy
options.body: Maintainers pause this PR and request a stricter or opt-in Mattermost policy before changing unmentioned thread delivery.

recommendation.title: Accept Default-On After Roundtrip
recommendation.body: Maintainers accept the default-on parity behavior and require or explicitly waive a real Mattermost bot-authored thread reply proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: amknight authored the prior merged Mattermost participated-thread work and this follow-up, making them the best available owner to frame the default-on behavior choice.
